note: Concepts are intentionally small, original, social, clip-friendly experiments. Scores are pre-build heuristics and must be replaced/updated with real player data after launch.

ideas.title: Panic Package
ideas.one_sentence_hook: Deliver the wrong-looking package through a chaotic obstacle course before the timer exposes you.
ideas.core_loop: Pick a package -> navigate hazards -> deliver to the matching receiver -> earn upgrade tokens -> harder round.
ideas.social_mechanic: Players can accidentally interfere with or help each other during deliveries.
ideas.novelty_claim: Delivery gameplay built around visual confusion and social interference rather than a standard simulator.
ideas.build_scope: One compact map, four hazard types, timer, package/receiver matching, round loop, simple upgrades.

ideas.title: The Floor Is Voted
ideas.one_sentence_hook: Every round players vote which part of the floor disappears next.
ideas.core_loop: Survive -> vote on a modifier -> survive the resulting layout -> last players standing win.
ideas.social_mechanic: Voting directly changes the arena and creates alliances/bluffs.
ideas.novelty_claim: The players collectively author the next hazard instead of a fixed random sequence.
ideas.build_scope: Single modular arena, tile removal, voting UI, rounds, respawn/win state.
notes: Highest social score; needs strong visual identity to avoid feeling generic.

ideas.title: One Button Chaos
ideas.one_sentence_hook: Everyone shares one button that triggers a random world-changing event.
ideas.core_loop: Enter room -> players decide when to press shared button -> survive event -> collect points -> next room.
ideas.social_mechanic: Timing the shared button creates cooperation and betrayal.
ideas.novelty_claim: A single shared input creates the entire strategy layer.
ideas.build_scope: Small room generator, 12 events, shared button, score table.

ideas.title: Tiny Crew Heist
ideas.one_sentence_hook: Three players must steal a ridiculous object while each player secretly has a different side objective.
ideas.core_loop: Get contract -> sneak through tiny map -> complete hidden objectives -> escape -> unlock harder contract.
ideas.social_mechanic: Asymmetric objectives create uncertainty about teammates' motives.
ideas.novelty_claim: Very small heist maps designed around fast asymmetric social rounds.
ideas.build_scope: One compact heist map, three roles, six objectives, simple guard AI.
notes: Very strong but more expensive to prototype because of role logic and NPC behavior.

ideas.title: Wrong Door
ideas.one_sentence_hook: You have seconds to choose a door, and the game learns your habits to fool you.
ideas.core_loop: Read clues -> choose door -> survive/fail -> clues become harder -> chase best streak.
ideas.social_mechanic: Players can spectate streaks and challenge friends' best runs.
ideas.novelty_claim: The challenge adapts to player choice patterns instead of only increasing speed.
ideas.build_scope: Door room, clue generator, adaptive difficulty, streak board.
